notes.title: "Koi-Koi Japan : Hana-Awase Rule Add-On" DLC is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
Let's enjoy Hanafuda even more with a different way of playing from "Koi-Koi"!

This is one of the rules for playing Hanafuda with three people.
Take out the cards in order, and combine the flowers on the cards you put out with the flowers on the field to make your own card.
When everyone's hand runs out, the game ends, and the points are competed based on the score of the collected cards and the score of the role.
Some roles are different between "Koi-Koi" and "Hana-Awase".

For more about the game check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491860/]here[/url].

Thank you!

notes.title: Japanese Table Game bundle released!
notes.content:
We hope you have enjoyed playing Koi-Koi Japan. If you like Japanese table games then we have a new bundle for you!

◆[b]Table Game Bundle[/b] contains two of the most famous Japanese table games including:
・Koi-Koi Japan [Hanafuda playing cards]
・Mahjong Nagomi

Enjoy Japanese-style Mahjong and also Koi-Koi which is played with Japanese "[i]hanafuda[/i]" flower cards.  Both games support multiplayer mode so you can play against your friends and other players from all over the world.  Or if you prefer you can enjoy single player mode and practice your skills or compete against AI players.

Complete-the-set and get 15% off whichever game you don't already own.  Or if you haven't had a chance to try either game then pick up both at the same time and save!

For more information check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16135/Table_Game_Bundle/]Table Game Bundle[/url].

Please appreciate Japanese culture and have a great playing experience at the same time!
